title: Smoky Mexican Tagine Chicken Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Mexican cuisine, this recipe combines smoky tagine chicken with fresh tomatoes and portuguese spices.

ingredients.name: Smoky Tagine Chicken
ingredients.notes: Boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

ingredients.name: Indulgent Port
ingredients.notes: Red wine or port wine for marinating

ingredients.name: Tortillas
ingredients.notes: Corn or flour tortillas for tacos

instructions: Marinate the chicken in port wine and portuguese spices for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Grill or bake the chicken until cooked through.
Chop the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté the chopped tomatoes in a pan with a little oil until softened.
Add the cooked chicken to the pan and stir to combine with the tomatoes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chicken and tomato mixture onto a tortilla, topping with cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
